content: Some individuals using continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) devices may develop skin irritation or allergic reactions caused by the adhesive or sensor materials used in these devices. It is essential to monitor and manage these reactions to ensure consistent and uninterrupted use of the CGM system. Furthermore, healthcare professionals should provide education to users regarding substances that could interfere with glucose readings. These substances may include certain medications or environmental factors, and understanding their impact is critical to improving the accuracy and reliability of CGM data.
